Name: MagicStorage
Author: yunsuyi
Description:
[line]


[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=6][b]魔法储存[/b][/size][/color][/center]


[center][color=#D4D4D8][i]把一整片箱子接成一张网络。[/i][/color][/center]


[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]描述[/b][/size]

把一整片箱子接成一张网络。你走到交互模块跟前点一下，就能存取整片箱子的东西；工作台合成、拾取掉落物，也都能直接和这张网络打交道。

它不替换原版箱子，也不强迫你把东西搬进某个"大仓库"。箱子还是那些箱子，只是从此以后，你不必再一个个打开它们。[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]安装说明[/b][/size][/color]


[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]安装 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]将本模组解压至 [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] 文件夹。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]使用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]主要功能[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]网络[/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]相邻的模块方块自动组网。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]绑定相同标签的网络合并为同一网络，实现无线连接。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]储存接口将相邻容器接入网络。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]交互界面[/b][/size]

物品交互界面提供了丰富的功能：[/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]鼠标滚轮支持、分类按钮、排序按钮、搜索框。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]搜索支持汉字、全拼、首字母、混写、物品ID等。空格分隔多个词时须全部命中。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]为网络中物品提供丰富的分类类别。[/color][/*]
[/list][table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]操作[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]效果[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]左键[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]搬一组[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]右键[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]搬一个[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Shift+右键[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]搬半组[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Shift+左键[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]快速存入[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]物品拾取[/b][/size]

玩家装备谐振核心后，拾取掉落物时，符合过滤的物品进入网络，其余进入背包。

[size=4][b]自动化[/b][/size]

安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] 后，自动化接口以容器身份接入自动化系统：机器产物首先返回网络，装备谐振核心后接口能主动向网络请求原料。[/color]


[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]前置[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=6][b]Magic Storage[/b][/size][/color][/center]


[center][color=#D4D4D8][i]Connect a whole wall of chests into one network.[/i][/color][/center]


[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

Connect a whole wall of chests into one network. Walk up to an Interaction Module, click once, and you can access everything stored across the entire network. Workbench crafting and item pickup can talk to that same network directly.

It does not replace vanilla chests, and it does not force you to move everything into some "big warehouse." The chests stay where they are — you just never have to open them one by one again.[/color]


[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]


[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract this mod into the [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Network[/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adjacent module blocks automatically form a network.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Networks bound to the same label merge into one, no physical adjacency required.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Storage Interfaces connect nearby containers into the network.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Interaction Interface[/b][/size]

The item interaction interface offers a rich set of features:[/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mouse wheel support, category buttons, sort buttons, and a search box.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Search supports Chinese characters, full pinyin, initials, mixed input, item IDs, and more. Multiple words separated by spaces must all match.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Rich item categories for everything in the network.[/color][/*]
[/list][table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Action[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Effect[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Left click[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]Move a stack[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Right click[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]Move one[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Shift + right click[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]Move half a stack[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Shift + left click [/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]Quick deposit[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Item Pickup[/b][/size]

When the player has a Resonance Core equipped, picked-up drops that match the filter go into the network; everything else goes into the inventory as usual.

[size=4][b]Automation[/b][/size]

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] installed, the Automation Interface joins the automation system as a container: machine output is returned to the network first, and with a Resonance Core equipped the interface can actively request ingredients from the network.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]
[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=5]Credits & Shout outs[/size][/b]

[size=3]如果没有星露谷模组社区的繁荣，这个模组将无法存在，尤其是 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] 大佬对社区做出的巨大贡献！[/size]

[i]This mod wouldn't exist without the thriving Stardew Valley modding community, especially the massive contributions made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]![/i]
